statement: Names in m_vlsit_afifo_* modules shall use REF-003 NAM-08 abbreviations and be at most 30 characters.

Input bit i_data[i] shall connect to i_d and o_q shall be o_data[i].
Option 0 is a bypass (o_q = i_d, 0 stages); options 1 and 2 give 2 stages, option 3 gives 3, option 4 gives 4, with metastability-model chains in simulation.
PARA_AFIFO_CELL_TYPE above 4 shall not be used; the wrapper gives the option 4 cell and behavior is undefined.
Every flop of a synchronizer model shall reset to the reset value bit.
Option 0 shall not be used for the pointer crossings of this IP because it breaks the read margin of at least 2 destination edges.

The synthesis branch shall instantiate the cells of 000_Common/rtl_cells named u_dont_touch_.
The simulation branch shall not use the example cells and shall contain the metastability model with random extra latency of REQ-VER-001.
The synthesis branch shall be verified with VLSIT_SYNTHESIS defined per option, and the simulation branch alone per option (latency 0, 2, 2, 3, 4 and reset value).

With random clock ratios (write faster, read faster, equal, drift) there must be no data error and no flag error.

The sequence completes and the flush check is never violated.
Behavior in TEST-002 to TEST-004 must be the same as after a hardware reset.
Behavior must follow DEC-031 and DEC-032.
Full and empty are never both 1.
A Gray pointer register changes at most one bit per cycle.
The write pointer and storage remain unchanged.

No write is accepted while wr_blk = 1.

statement: The IP owns the timing constraints of the crossings EXC-001..003, EXC-005 and EXC-006.
The SoC owns the clock definitions and I/O delays; the IP does not specify them.
i_clk_wr and i_clk_rd are primary clocks, asynchronous to each other for functional paths except the listed exceptions, with no frequency or ratio restriction.
EXC-001: set_max_delay -datapath_only from write Gray pointer registers to first synchronizer stage D pins in m_vlsit_afifo_rd must be 0.9 x i_clk_wr period.
EXC-002: set_max_delay -datapath_only from read Gray pointer registers to first synchronizer stage D pins in m_vlsit_afifo_wr must be 0.9 x i_clk_rd period.
EXC-003: set_max_delay -datapath_only from storage elements or macro output through the read path to storage output register D pins must be at most 1 x i_clk_rd period.
EXC-004: i_full_thr and i_empty_thr are set_false_path static configuration inputs, written once before use and not changed while the FIFO is in use.
EXC-006: set_max_delay -datapath_only from ack_rd register to first stage D pin of the acknowledge synchronizer in m_vlsit_afifo_wr must be 0.9 x i_clk_rd period.

The bounded-delay constraints and the CDC analysis shall cover the crossings separately.
The synchronizer stages of one bit should be placed adjacent to each other.

statement: No FIFO operation (write or read) starts before both write and read domains have left reset.

The RTL contains no elaboration check for parameter values; behavior with an illegal parameter value is undefined.
Defaults are 2 synchronizer stages, depth 8, data width 32; depth is a power of 2 with no upper limit, data width minimum 1 with no upper limit.

statement: o_overflow and o_underflow must be registered 1-cycle pulses appearing in the cycle after the rejected request.

The model randomizes each bit's latency independently as S-1, S or S+1 cycles after the first capturing edge; a new input change during the delay replaces the pending change and restarts the delay.
The metastability model is controlled by plusargs for seed and enable.
The SRAM wrapper and model implement a generic one-write-port, one-read-port foundry-style interface.

statement: Timing exceptions: set_max_delay 0.9 x write clock period for the write pointer, 0.9 x read clock period for the read pointer, 1 x read clock period for the data path; static thresholds use a false path; no set_min_delay.

The macro VLSIT_SYNTHESIS selects branches only in m_vlsit_afifo_cell_sync: with the macro is the synthesizable model, without is the simulation model; simulation defines it for the synthesizable branch, synthesis and analysis flows define it.
Storage read is synchronous: the read module drives the next read pointer address, storage is read every read-clock cycle, o_rd_data is the storage output, with no memory read enable.
The software reset input i_rst_n_sw is active-low level (0 = reset requested), idle value 1, synchronous to i_clk_wr and sampled at the clock, not an asynchronous reset.
i_rst_n_sw may be low for one write-clock cycle or any longer time; the FSM latches the request and waits in HOLD while it is low.
o_sw_rst_busy must be driven directly by a flip-flop with no combinational logic on the output path.

not_verified.note: Flop-driven output structure. The observable part is in CHK-012.

statement: o_full must be 1 while the write side is blocked by the software reset and return to normal full logic at write release.

A side is released only when the synchronized pointer of the other side is 0.

statement: Library wrappers, cells and macro models are written in common_rtl/000_Common (rtl_lib and rtl_cells), each folder with its own filelist.f.
